subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale pin assertions are repaired, should the token-, registry-, CodeQL-, Blacksmith-, and Codex-bearing action upgrades land as one grouped update or be split into smaller security review units?
rationale: Source inspection supports the official immutable pins and compatible interfaces, but accepting several privileged third-party implementations together is a supply-chain boundary choice for the workflow and security owners.

options.title: Approve repaired group
options.body: Keep the grouped update and approve it only after the guards are synchronized and exact-head workflow and security validation passes.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate credential-bearing, scanning, and agent action updates for narrower review and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired group
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update and approve it only after the guards are synchronized and exact-head workflow and security validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled cross-workflow history and owns the repository CODEOWNERS file, while secops owns several touched security workflows.
